values.note: Gogebic County 2027 rates: nightly $35 for residents and non-residents alike; monthly $850 non-resident, $750 for Gogebic County residents (promo code RESIDENT, residency verified at check-in). Cancellation more than a day ahead refunds all but one night.

values.note: Camping season runs from mid-May to October 10 (2027).
Online only, through the county's NewBook page; reservations open the second Monday in January each year. One reservation per site occupant and date range.

booking.source: https://www.gogebicforestryandparks.com/littlegirlspoint ('Reservations for the Little Girl's Point County Park begin the second Monday in January each year via website only'; 'All reservations must be processed online'; make-a-reservation link to bookingsus.newbook.cloud/littlegirlspoint), read 2026-10-22

note: Gogebic County park on Lake Superior (Agate Beach), E1930 Lake Road, Ironwood, established 1920; several sites on the bluff overlooking the lake, with the Porcupine Mountains and Apostle Islands in view. Remote: fill the water tank before arriving; no public Wi-Fi and limited cell service. Boating access at the mouth of Oman's Creek. --Claude
summary: County page: 2027 nightly $35 (resident and non-resident; monthly $750/$850), 29 electric 30-50 A + 2 non-electric sites, water tanker only, no dump station, vault restrooms, season mid-May to Oct 10, online-only booking (NewBook) opening the second Monday of January. Fees now 2027 (same $35); added vault toilets, season close 10-10, booking platform/url/note; hookups/sites/water/dump now manual. Flush toilets / no showers (derived) not stated by the page; left. Note cleaned of the site, hookup, facility, fee and booking text.
